notes:
Summary: Mid-market SaaS (developer platform) evaluating Redwood Hosted initially for fast time-to-value, then move to Redwood Dedicated (VPC) for production traffic. Product team cares about predictable latency, cost controls and tight security controls before committing to Dedicated.

Discovery timeline (brief):
- 2025-11-18: Intro call (Maya) — high level fit, use cases: in-editor code-assistant + doc search + support chat. Good product alignment; want hosted API for quick POC.
- 2025-12-08: Technical deep-dive (Rahul) — infra + latency targets. Agreed to 2-week POC.
- 2026-01-06: POC kickoff — provided sample prompts, test dataset (50k tokens/day target).
- 2026-01-28: Security pre-call with InfoSec (ff_2026-01-28_sec-call). Asked for SOC2 scope, SAML/SCIM, audit log schema.
- 2026-02-10: Demo w/ product + infra teams (ff_2026-02-10_PNX-demo-1). Showed hosted streaming, function calling, and per-token cost breakdown.
- 2026-02-18: Pricing follow-up email thread (gthread:1704-Polaris-Redwood-pricing).
- 2026-02-22: Security packet delivered (partial) and follow-up meeting to review Dedicated/VPC options.

POC details / technical requirements:
- POC: 2 weeks hosted API, synthetic and production-ish traces. Goal: validate answer quality + latency SLOs before Dedicated procurement.
- Targets: p95 latency <120ms for short prompts (<128 tokens), consistent throughput 15-25 rps, cold-start token cost baseline.
- Workload mix: 60% code-assistant completions, 30% doc-search embeddings + reranking, 10% chat/support.
- Model preferences: prefer smaller quantized variants for Dedicated cost-savings; product team asked about Llama3-70B vs Redwood-curated 13B quantized. Need guidance on quality vs cost tradeoffs.
- Routing/fallback: must have automatic fallback to hosted variant if Dedicated capacity hit; routing policy configurable by region and cost tier.

Security / Compliance discussion (most important blocker):
- SOC2: Polaris requires SOC2 Type II report and mapping of Redwood controls to Polaris control matrix. They requested artifacts: latest SOC2 report + SOC2 controls mapping doc.
- SSO/SAML + SCIM: integration with Okta in place; SSO test tenant required. Polaris wants SAML metadata + SCIM user provisioning timeline (expected <2 weeks after contract).
- Audit logs: need MFA'd, tamper-evident audit logs covering admin actions, model version changes, and data access. Retention asked: default 1 year, ability to extend to 7 years for legal/regulatory.
- KMS / keys: Customer-managed keys (KMS) for model request encryption at rest and option for HSM for Dedicated. Polaris legal flagged key separation for analytics pipelines.
- VPC & network: VPC peering and restrictive egress rules mandatory. They want network diagram and port/IP ranges for firewall allowlist.
- Data residency / retention controls: retention policies per workload type; embeddings retention TTLs and ability to auto-delete after set intervals.

Quotes / call snippets:
- Product lead: "We need the POC to reflect production latency — if it's slower in-prod we'll lose trust."
- InfoSec: "SOC2 + SAML + an auditable log trail — that's non-negotiable for Dedicated."
- AE note: "Polaris will sign if Dedicated network + SOC2 questions are satisfied and price fits mid-market ARR band."

Commercial / pricing notes:
- Pricing ask: predictable committed capacity for Dedicated with burst buffer; Polaris prefers 12-month reserve with quarterly true-ups.
- Estimated ARR ask: looking for 60k-180k ARR range depending on model selection/quantization savings.
- AE shared draft pricing (see /drive/polaris/presentations/redwood-pricing-v1.pdf).

Action items / open tasks (owner in parens):
- Deliver full SOC2 Type II report + controls mapping (Maya) — sent partial packet 2026-02-22, need final artifacts.
- Provide SAML metadata + SCIM plan and Okta test steps (Rahul) — aim to demo in security walkthrough.
- Share VPC network diagram + firewall port list (Infra eng) — request by 2026-03-01.
- POC monitoring dashboard template + cost burn projection (Solutions Eng) — attach sample.
- Prepare Dedicated sizing guide comparing 13B quantized vs 70B baseline for Polaris workload (APPLIED ML).

Next meeting: security walkthrough with Polaris InfoSec + infra (30–45m), propose wk of 2026-03-01. Primary aim: clear blockers for procurement (SOC2 evidence + network configurations).

CRM notes / shorthand:
- Good cultural fit, engineering-first. PLG-friendly but needs enterprise guardrails.
- Sensitivity to per-token cost — push Optimize recommendations during POC.
- Legal will want retention language in contract.

Stubs / references:

- Gmail threads: gthread:1704-Polaris-Redwood-pricing (pricing negotiation).
- Jira RDW-4892: internal request for SOC2 artifacts generation.

AE final note (2026-02-22): Polaris is likely to convert if we can clear InfoSec checklist within 2–3 weeks and align on 12-month Dedicated pricing. Keep demo running until procurement completes.
